productSpec.name: ReceiptPretty
productSpec.thesis: Stripe's default receipts are ugly and unprofessional. Businesses want branded, beautiful receipts without hiring a designer or writing code.
productSpec.targetUser: Indie hackers and small SaaS founders who use Stripe
productSpec.mvpFeatures:
- Connect Stripe account (OAuth)
- Choose from 5 receipt templates
- Add logo and brand colors
- Auto-send branded receipts
productSpec.distribution: Post in Indie Hackers, tweet to dev Twitter, Stripe developer communities

founderContext.domainExperience: Built 3 SaaS products, uses Stripe daily
founderContext.existingAudience: 2K Twitter followers in indie hacker space, active on Indie Hackers forum
